Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter assays where assay_organism is Homo sapiens. Return the results sorted by compound ChEMBL ID.
